title: Evaluation preserved by recursive combination
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ specify an AND or OR gate, let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on those variables. For every natural number $k$, the circuit obtained by recursively combining $cs$ with fuel $k$ has the same value under $x$ as the single gate of type $b$ applied to the circuits in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
$cs$ is a finite list of circuits on $n$ variables
